identity_model.drone_membership_model: assimilation/collective-connection state, not citizenship or ordinary employment
identity_model.liberated_or_disconnected_rule: Individual remains same persistent entity with changed collective connection state.

authority_and_coordination.queen_or_centralized_manifestation_handl: era/encounter-specific authoritative state; do not assume omnipresent direct control in every scene

diplomacy.rule: Temporary cooperation does not create normal diplomatic membership or trust.

ai_guardrails: Do not treat Borg as a species.
Do not create assimilation success, adaptation or liberation through dialogue.
Do not infer Collective knowledge as total World Truth.
Do not erase origin identity/history of a drone.
